name: opencascade
status_note: NOT yet executed. The prefix in use today is a Homebrew bottle; see binary_provenance in deps.lock.json. Promoting to 'proven' means running this recipe and having `tools/deps/forge_deps.py verify --full` accept the resulting prefix.

features.note: Forge links a deliberately small toolkit subset (the OCCT-zero programme). The modules below are the ones whose toolkits appear on the link line in forge-kernel/CMakeLists.txt; everything else is off so the built prefix is smaller and the closure is auditable.

smoke_test.description: Dependency smoke test required by s10.6's OFFLINE_BUILD step. Configure forge-kernel against the activated prefix and assert the version pin is read from THIS prefix.

known_gaps: The Apple SDK and compiler are not pinned, so this recipe does not yet yield a bit-reproducible prefix — only a source-reproducible one.

INSTALL_DIR_LAYOUT=Unix puts headers at include/opencascade, matching what forge-kernel/CMakeLists.txt expects. If upstream changes that layout the presence_marker check fails loudly rather than silently mis-including.
